title: Te Awhi o te Ao
intro: I te wā o ngā whakamātautau nui, i whakawhiwhia tētahi tangata rongonui ki te nui o te taonga o te ao, he whakamātautau mō te whakawhetai me te ngākau mahaki. Ko te haerenga a tēnei tangata he akoranga hohonu mō te āhua poto o ngā taonga me ngā hua o te whakapehapeha. Kimihia te tuakiri o tēnei wairua kua whakairohia tōna kōrero ki te whenua i raro i a tātou.
clues: I noho ahau i waenganui i tētahi iwi i arahina e tētahi karere nui.
Nā te Atua ahau i homai he taonga nui ki ahau, ā, ko ngā kī ki aku taonga i waiho hei kawenga taimaha mā te tini o te hunga kaha.

I te mōhio o tōku iwi ki ōku taonga, ka tohutohu mai rātou ki ahau kia rapu i te kāinga o te ao tūroa me ngā mea kua homai e Allah ki ahau, kaua hoki e wareware ki taku wāhi o te ao, me te mahi i te pai pērā i tā Allah mahi pai ki ahau.
I runga i te whakapehapeha i kī ahau nāku ake mōhiotanga me taku mahi i whiwhi ai ahau i aku taonga nui, me te whakakahore i tetahi manaakitanga o te atua.
I te wā i tonoa ai ahau kia koha, kia mihi rānei ki ngā manaakitanga a Allah, i whakakahore whakahīhī ahau, i te whakapono nōku anake aku taonga.
Nā te nui o tōku whakapehapeha me tōku tukino, ka whakahau a Allah i te whenua kia tuwhera, kia horomia ahau me tōku whare.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
